scripts.build:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.copy:static: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/static', 'dist/static', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.copy:package: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = require('./package.json'); delete pkg.devDependencies; delete pkg.scripts; if (pkg.imports && pkg.imports['#shared/*.js']) { pkg.imports['#shared/*.js'] = pkg.imports['#shared/*.js'].replace('./src/shared', './shared'); } fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));"
scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run copy:package && npm run copy:static
